# Southern Cubing welcomes you to Fort Worth for Southern Championship 2026!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI1NzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--93ed8c64ab3237522f6a77aeaf7a38f7b6469e82/Southerns%202026%20Logo%202-05.png)

### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63383-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Southern Champs 2026!**

The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63392-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63385-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63391-sponsors-and-partners).

### Håfa Adai, and welcome to the first ever competition in the Northern Mariana Islands! 🇲🇵

This competition serves as the premier competition for speedcubing in the Northern Mariana Islands. We welcome participants of all ages, skill levels, and nationalities to participate.

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 11:20 AM.

---

### 하파 아다이! 북마리아나 제도에서 열리는 첫 번째 대회에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 🇲🇵

이 대회는 북마리아나 제도 최고의 스피드큐빙 대회입니다. 모든 연령, 실력, 국적의 참가자를 환영합니다.

* 자리를 확보하려면 가능한 한 빨리 등록하는 것이 좋습니다.
* WCA 규정을 꼭 숙지하세요. 공식 대회에 처음 참가하시는 분이라면 이 [영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8)이 필요한 정보의 대부분을 제공해 드릴 것입니다.
* 처음으로 경쟁에 참가하는 경우 오전 11시 20분에 시작되는 경쟁자 튜토리얼에 참석하는 것이 좋습니다.

items.name: Frost-Free Favorites AZ 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67008-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

### Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition
Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**.  If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67007-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab.  Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers.  Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap.  You can still register to compete in both events;  you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.  

### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each.  This is due to venue space and limited seating available.

### Connect with the Arizona cubing community!
Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/)
Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing)

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Penn Cube Day Fall 2025
items.information:
* We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day hats for competitors.

* Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified.

* We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1.

* We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event.

* Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

* Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive.

* Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.information:

The only events held at this competition are blindfolded and fewest move events, which require a significant amount of concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to remain AS QUIET AS POSSIBLE throughout the day to allow competitors to concentrate.

Please consider registering for another competition, such as [UMBC Fall 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UMBCFall2025), if this one isn't for you.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information:
### Registration is currently full and the waitlist is now closed. We will no longer be accepting anymore competitors onto the waitlist for this competition.

#### Competitors from the waitlist will be accepted until Friday, September 19, 2025 at 5:00 PM, after which point all waitlisted competitors will not be able to compete. Competitors who do not make it off the waitlist will receive full refunds. Please click the [Waitlist](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXXI2025#64129-waitlist) tab for more details.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzYyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b461cbfe0cad33e2120f14293fe68e84c3bb5009/sac_transparent%20(1).png)

#### SacCubing returns with our 21st iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot!

*  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
* We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 40 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations.
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 9 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline.

This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information:
## Registration is now full and we are now utilizing a waitlist system. Please view the [Waitlist tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacMini2025#60106-waitlist) for details.
![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

#### SacCubing's first ever mini competition is here, presenting SacMini 2025! 

*  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
* We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
* All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.name: West Coast Cubing Tour: Los Angeles 2025
items.information:
Join us for the LA leg of the West Coast Cubing Tour!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzA0OTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--310605b25b0ecf790ae7a5eddc8b532d6493cd85/WCCT2.PNG)
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCTLosAngeles2025#43202-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1NKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--928aebc1c75f745abb0b80097896dba5180958fd/image.png)

This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels.

### UCLA Students
If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCTLosAngeles2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.

### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition, this time on the Windward Side!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 1:00 PM.

---

#### This competition will take place over the course of two days!
Please note that this competition will span more than one day. You are not required to attend both days of the competition if you are only competing in one day.

**Saturday Events:** 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Pyraminx, Skewb
**Sunday Events:** 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 MultiBlind

---

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
​
This is our second ever WCA competition at NYU after [NYU Winter 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NYUWinter2024)! 
​
**NYU ID POLICY:** New York University requires all adults to bring a government issued ID to sign in to NYU buildings. The organizers of this competition will have to submit a list of all visitors (which includes the competitor and their adult chaperone if the competitor is a minor) to the NYU visitor system after registration has been finalized. Read more about the [NYU Visitor Policy here](https://www.nyu.edu/about/visitor-information/sponsoring-visitors.html).
​
**MINORS POLICY:** New York University requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 in the venue must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to bring a government issued ID and sign in. 
​
**GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots.
​
**NYU Students and Alumni:** NYU students and alumni will receive a full refund for their registration. Please provide your NYU email in the comments of your registration and a full refund will be initiated once your registration is accepted.

items.information:
#Please check the schedule to find possible time slots.  Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in.
#Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1.  Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3.

- On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot.
- Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments.  We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed.  Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis.  If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot.
- If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly.

*In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png)

#This is an expo first!  We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing!

- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition!
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
- Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo.  Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of.
- We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzIzNTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--dc05479e34fabbdd9670adb78e01bfe98d431584/nvchampslogo.png)

Welcome to Nevada Championship 2025! The first ever state championship held in Nevada!
The competition is open to all, but only Nevada residents are eligible for state champion titles. See NV Champion Eligibility for more info.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.


**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.


#### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration**
Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following:
1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration.
2. Changes to registration (if applicable).
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.


#### **Staff Member Registration**
Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition. 
For this competition all staff members must fill out the form in the Staff Applications tab. If you do not fill out this form you will not be able to staff this competition.

items.name: Minnesota Newcomer Sunday 2025
items.information:
## *Minnesota Newcomer Series!*
### This is a very beginner-friendly competition!  All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDQ5NTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e4d3d627bab4a223c8186cae9154e1a8617a8fd8/Snip20241111_14.png)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2025).  You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.**

[Please click here for more information about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSunday2025#51636-series-competitions-faq)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTMzNzAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--34dde97d7ff849d5c25eeebbf9ecb53d154078da/newcomer%202025.png)

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

* 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
* Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 12-31-2024)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: Rocklin Winter 2024
items.information:
Get ready for another Rocklin competition!

### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.name: Centennial State Cube Off 2024
items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Erie for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. 
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:00 PM UTC 12-06-2024)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information:
**THIS COMPETITION TAKES PLACE ON A MONDAY EVENING**

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 30 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!

Since this is a small competition, we expect all competitors to be helping throughout the majority of the competition to make sure we stay on schedule.

Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:00 PM UTC 12-06-2024)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information:
## NOTE: This competition will be held on a Sunday!

## PSU students must leave their PSU email as a comment on their registration to qualify for the discounted registration fee of $10. The full registration fee ($25) must be paid, and then qualifying registrations will receive the refund.

## Competitors may bring at most one guest. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.

## In accordance with University policy all competitors 17 years of age and younger MUST have their legal guardian accompanying them to this competition.

## All proceeds from the event will be going to the PSU Rubik's Cube Club.

* Competitors may bring at most one guest.
* Heritage Hall is located on the first floor of the HUB. This is NOT the same room as Happy Valley Spring 2024. To easily get to Heritage Hall inside the HUB-Robeson Center, you may take any of the elevators on the food court level up to the first floor **except for the elevator next to the Panda Express/Sbarro shops**. From there, Heritage Hall should be just within range to your left or right.

How to get to Venue: There are two entrances. If you entered through the doors with a sky bridge above, turn left to take elevators or turn left at the middle of the building to go upstairs.
If you entered through the side with a field, take the elevators at the end of the building on the right or turn right at the middle of the building to go upstairs.

This competition is sponsored by the Pi Kappa Phi Ability Experience. The Ability Experience is the philanthropic initiative of the Pi Kappa Phi fraternity dedicated to aiding the 6.5 million citizens living with disabilities across the United States. Together, we’re helping to change the way society views people with disabilities because labels should not define us. We put our values into action, bringing our mission for a more inclusive community to life every single day. 

For more information about the Ability Experience, please click on the Sponsors/Charity Info tab. All excess funds and donations from this competition will be donated to the Ability Experience.

[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085))

This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 

NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085))

This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 

NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.name: Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa05zIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c3e44aec5cbb0ee93127339ad0d85620fe1e8c43/All-Star%202024%20Logo.png)
## Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024

[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) are excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at the Mall of America® in Bloomington, Minnesota! 

## Qualification

To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-7.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before March 21, 2024.

If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Midwest area, including [Minnesota Warm Up 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaWarmUp2024) on July 13 and July 14, also being held at the Mall of America! 

We also invite you to watch Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 via the livestream, or if you are in the area stop by the Mall of America® and watch it live!

## Spectators and Livestream

We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details.

The event will be open to in-person spectators who will be able to view this competition from mulitple levels of the Mall of America®, including on the jumbotron that will be projected in the Huntington Bank Rotunda. Reserved VIP seating will also be available for up to two guests for each competitor.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 competition consent to their images being used by Midwest Cubing Association and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Quiet Seattle Spring 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuietSeattleSpring2024#40461-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085))

This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 

NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.information:
#Please check the schedule to find possible time slots.  Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in.
#Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1.  Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3.

- On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot.
- Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments.  We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed.  Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis.  If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot.
- If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly.

*In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

items.information:
All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is March 30th, 2023 at 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until March 30th, 2023 at 5:00 PM Mountain Time. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

# This competition is in celebration of WCA Newcomer Month! This competition is catered to all speedcubing newcomers and we welcome you to register for this competition!

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 40% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

40% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 60% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 40% of new competitors register before 60% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information:
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:**
* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:**

* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
* If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month).

items.information:
Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose!

## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube.

## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first.

The registration fee for this competition is $32; however, if you have registered and paid the full fee for [BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC56BASED2024), you can register for this competition for a discounted fee of $20.

**IMPORTANT: For technical reasons, you will have to pay the $32 fee in full, even if you are eligible for the discounted fee.** Once you have paid the full fee for both competitions, we will issue a $12 refund to bring your total payment down to $20.

Competition Day Timing:
* The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
* Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
* Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
* Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww

items.information:
Welcome back for a second reindition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering
 
**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 30 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

#### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration**
Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following:
1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration.
2. Changes to registration (if appplicable).
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

#### **Check-In**
Competitors will receive a name tag.

#### **Staff Member Registration**
Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered registration free of charge in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition.

items.information:

If you are on the [competitor list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GetToWorkChicagoland2023/registrations) and are no longer planning on competing in this competition, please cancel your registration. We are not responsible for no-shows if we begin an event early, and you miss your opprotunity to compete. We need to keep the competition moving along, so we recommend arriving 20-30 minutes before you are scheduled to compete/judge. We may also change the original schedule after competitors register for the competition based on registration numbers for each event, but we will not add or remove full events or change the order of events.

items.name: Colorado Jungle Jumble 2023

venue.name: Denver Zoo
venue.details: Find Norgren Hall in the Gates Center to the right after entering the zoo

items.information:
**This competition will take place inside of the Denver Zoo. The price of your registration will cover the cost of admission to the zoo, as well as lunch at one of the restaurants inside the zoo. You MUST read the tab about tickets and lunch before registering to ensure that you are able to get into the zoo.**

This competition is managed financially by Colorado Cubers, a non-profit association. We understand that the registration fees for this competition are higher than usual, but please recognize that everyone working these competitions is a volunteer and our organization will be taking a considerable loss as a result of this event. We hope to be able to put on a unique experience that will be enjoyable for everyone.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering

There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition.

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also perform some modifications to their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, no refund will be offered due to the budget for this competition but we will give your spot to a different cuber eager to compete!

The deadline to cancel your registration is July 14th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. The deadline to edit your registration is July 28th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.


**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until July 14th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

Events: 3x3, 2x2, 6x6, Clock, and Pyraminx

**Competitors may bring at most one guest.**

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof that they satisfy one of the following two requirements in order to be allowed in the venue:

- **They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19.** To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after **Saturday, May 27** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

 OR

- **They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition.** The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than **Tuesday, June 6** is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

items.name: CubingUSA Heartland Championship 2023
items.information:
The [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) 2023 Heartland [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) will be in Independence, Missouri!

Residents of the following states/territories are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion: Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota. 

We have three local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. venue.name: Santa Clara Convention Center
venue.address: 5001 Great America Pkwy, Santa Clara, CA 95054

items.information:
This competition takes place in a large sports convention.  Competitors (and parents of competitors) are allowed early entry.  Please aim to be there at 9am.  If you arrive at 10am, you will not get in by the start of 3x3.

Since this is a convention, we will not have dedicated tables for cubers as you would see at many competitions.  There will be areas throughout the convention you will be able to hang out and grab tables with others.  Because of this, we will be heavily relying on [dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts).  Please make sure you are registered with  [dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts) before the competition starts.   [Dropofftable](https://www.dropofftable.com/competition/BayAreaSpeedcubin442023/alerts) is a texting service that texts you when you are supposed to compete, judge, scramble, or run.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Guests must pay for a ticket at the convention ($25).  This is not paid to us, this is paid to the convention.  You can purchase that at the competition, or online at [https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/event-tickets](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/event-tickets).

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

# This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly.


All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering

There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition.

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund ($18.75 USD).

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is Feburary 4th , 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.


**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until Feburary 4th, 2022 at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

### If you are interested in normal speedsolving events, please look into other competitions in this area, and stay tuned for future announcements

3x3 Multiple Blindfolded is the main event of the competition. 

We are enforcing the following COVID regulations
* Masks are recommended to be worn at the competition
* You may only bring one guest maximum. We are heavily discouraging spectating due to the events not being spectator friendly.
* Outside spectators are not permitted. 

These restrictions may strengthen if local mandates are enforced or if cases rise. Please check back frequently.
Please view our Competitor Responsibilities and COVID Safety tab before registering. 

### *By signing up, you agree to contribute throughout the entirety of the competition due to the small size*.

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of a negative test for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. A rapid test is acceptable proof for a negative result. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Competitors and guests are *strongly recommended* to wear masks during the day to help prevent spread and protect themselves from COVID-19. Additionally, competitors are *strongly recommended* to bring at most one guest.

Competitors should read the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19453-competitor-information) tab. Spectators may attend for free, but due to room capacity limitations, guests should be kept to a minimum. Since blindsolving requires a high level of concentration, all attendees are required to be silent during blindfolded events. Guests and competitors may socialize freely in Haines Hall Room A28, on the same floor as the competition venue. All attendees are required to read the [COVID-19 Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindIsBackLA2022#19452-covid-19-safety) tab.

items.name: Princeton Spring 2022

venue.name: [Princeton University](http://www.princeton.edu/)
venue.address: Frist Campus Center, Frist Ln, Princeton, NJ 08544

items.information:
If you would like to be on the competitor list, please carefully note exactly when registration opens, and sign up as soon as possible. This competition has filled up very quickly in the past, so do not miss out. Please see other tabs for more information.

**MINORS POLICY:** Princeton University now requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 that plans to compete must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to sign in. (Please reach out to the organizer with any issues/questions.)

**COVID POLICY:** Princeton University is requiring that all visitors attest to being fully immunized against COVID-19. You are considered fully immunized after **both** of the below conditions are met:
* At least 2 weeks after your second dose in a 2-dose series, such as the Pfizer or Moderna vaccines, or 2 weeks after a single-dose vaccine, such as Johnson & Johnson.
* Received booster if more than 6 months since the second dose of a two-dose series or if more than 2 months since a single dose of J&J.
Individuals who are not fully immunized may not enter campus buildings.

The organizers also request that competitors and guests wear a mask for the duration of the competition.

**GUEST POLICY:** Each competitor is allowed to bring only 1 guest. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots - we are limiting the venue to holding 150 people total.

items.information:
Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. 

Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab.

**Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves
**Day 2:**  5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks
**Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb

Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. 

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. venue.address: 275 Mt Carmel Ave, Hamden, CT 06518, USA
venue.details: The competition will take place in the main gymnasium. There is a parking lot in front which has free parking.

items.information:
Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect.

The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt.

Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity.

We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.information:
Registration Fee:
There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. Please do not register unless you intend on competing as it will open up a spot for another competitor who does intend on competing.

**We will only be accepting online payment at this competition. If you have any issues with this, please contact us!**

There is a **25 competitor limit** to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on July 7th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by July 7th, but no refunds are granted after that date.
